newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes Aviation wins O'Hare slots.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes Aviation wins O'Hare slots.

text.p: Great Lakes Aviation Ltd said on Friday it has received approval for 20 takeoff and landing slots at Chicago O'Hare International Airport.
Great Lakes said it will, over the next three to six months, begin to offer service on nonstop United Express flights to Dubuque, Iowa; Sioux Falls, S.D.; and Fargo, N.D. to and from Chicago O'Hare.

Preliminary plans call for four weekday roundtrips at Dubuque, three roundtrips at Fargo and three or possibly four nonstop roundtrips at Sioux Falls, the carrier said in a statement. All flights will be scheduled to make connections at Chicago 0'Hare.

Great Lakes operates a fleet of 52 aircraft under three marketing identities -- United Express in the upper Midwest, Midway Connection in the southeastern U.S., and as Great Lakes Airlines in Arizona, New Mexico and Mexico as well as several routes in the Midwest. It provides scheduled service at 81 airports in 20 states, the District of Columbia and Sonora, Mexico.
Shares of Great Lakes Aviation closed off 1/8 to three.
